items.title: China Stock Premium Over Hong Kong Widens on State Intervention
items.summary: Beijing’s efforts to stabilize its equity markets are helping drive the pricing gap between dual-listed stocks in China and Hong Kong to the widest level in nearly 17 months.

items.title: TVS family feud: Venu Srinivasan, son and wife along with daughter file caveats
items.summary: TVS Motor Co. chairman-emeritus Venu Srinivasan, son Sudarshan Venu, wife Mallika Srinivasan, and daughter Lakshmi Venu have filed a total of eight caveats in two Chennai courts

items.title: Bitcoin’s Road to $100,000 Is Crowded With Would-Be Sellers
items.summary: Bitcoin investors cheered as their favorite coin rebounded over the summer. With the turn of the season, they’ve been left with a nagging question: why did the rally fizzle out?

items.title: Sunteck Realty, Radico Khaitan, WeWork India, Supreme Industries, Kajaria: Jefferies sees up to 64% upside; target price
items.summary: Jefferies India has reduced target price in Suntech Realty, Supreme Industries shares

items.title: Sebi may ease extra disclosure rules for foreign portfolio investors
items.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) is reassessing its strict extra disclosure protocols for foreign portfolio investors. These protocols demand comprehensive investor data from funds with specific asset levels and concentrated equity risks. Sebi aims to reinforce market transparency while averting measures that could destabilize the financial landscape.

items.title: Arctos Sees Rise of Private Equity Zombies as Firm Count Peaks
items.summary: The number of active private markets firms peaked 18 months ago and has started to decline as more firms become zombies because they’re not able to raise their next fund, according to Arctos Partners Chief Executive Officer Ian Charles.

items.title: Bullish Treasury Bets Face Reversal Risk From Hawkish Fed
items.summary: Bullish bets in US Treasuries are vulnerable to a sharp reversal if the Federal Reserve takes a more aggressive stance at its upcoming monetary policy meeting.

items.title: US stocks today: US stocks end higher as AI rally lifts Nasdaq ahead of Fed decision
items.summary: US stocks saw gains as renewed optimism about artificial intelligence lifted chipmakers while corporate earnings were evaluated. Although concerns about AI spending persist, news of Anthropic's IPO provided a relief rally for the sector. The Federal Reserve began its policy meeting, with expectations for interest rates to remain unchanged. Nearly half of S&P 500 companies reported earnings, with many exceeding…

items.title: Know your risks, diversify, & skip tips: Lessons from Smart Investor Arena
items.summary: At the BFSI Insight Summit 2026's Smart Investor Arena, experts urged investors to set financial goals, diversify portfolios, avoid herd mentality and understand risks before investing

items.title: Crypto investors must research; invest only what they can lose: Experts
items.summary: At the Business Standard Smart Investor Arena 2026, experts urged young investors to understand crypto fundamentals, start small and assess risks as tokenisation and stablecoins gain ground.

items.title: Delhi may raise agricultural land circle rates to ₹5 crore per acre
items.summary: The proposed changes seek to bridge the gap between official land valuations and market prices across Delhi’s districts and localities

items.title: Derivatives trading may need more guardrails, says Sebi WTM Murty
items.summary: At the BFSI Insight Summit 2026, Sebi's KVR Murty said retail derivatives trading may need more guardrails amid expiry-day hyperactivity, stressing investor protection and market integrity.

items.title: SIFs offer better risk-adjusted returns: Rishi Kohli, Jyotivardhan Jaipuria
items.summary: At the Business Standard Smart Investor Arena, fund managers said SIFs may suit investors seeking risk-adjusted returns, while PMS offers higher return potential with greater volatility

items.title: Piramal Pharma swings to ₹5 crore profit in Q2 as revenue rises 28%
items.summary: The Mumbai-based pharmaceutical company recorded higher operating revenue during the quarter, while its total expenses also increased year-on-year

items.title: NYSE bets on all-or-nothing options as event driven trading gains traction
items.summary: NYSE is preparing to launch binary return options that will let investors make all-or-nothing bets on whether stocks and ETFs finish above or below set prices. The exchange is also seeking approval for KPI options linked to company earnings metrics, expanding the range of event-driven trading products available to investors.

items.title: India could have achieved over 8% GDP growth without external shocks: RBI Deputy Governor
items.summary: Poonam Gupta highlighted domestic investment, foreign capital and economic resilience as key factors shaping India’s growth prospects amid global uncertainty.

items.title: India in striking distance of 8% growth as reforms boost economy: Shaktikanta Das
items.summary: Das said the BFSI sector has a crucial role to play in India's journey from a lower-middle-income economy to a high-income economy, through its intermediation in allocation of financial resources. He said the sector would be required to support India's next-gen Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), be the frontline of green and transition finance and become the catalyst for democratising financial inclusion to…

items.title: Bajaj Auto faces drought squeeze, eyes Japan entry through KTM
items.summary: Bajaj Auto is balancing weaker demand among price-sensitive buyers with international expansion prospects as its Austrian partner recovers from financial distress

items.title: ASM Lifts 2027 Outlook as AI Buildout Fuels Demand For Tools
items.summary: ASM International NV increased its revenue target for next year by about 24%, setting up the chip-equipment maker to hit its 2030 goal three years ahead of schedule, on a surge in sales linked to AI investments.

items.title: The HRX Case Study: How Hrithik Roshan leveraged sweat equity, Myntra’s supply chain to conquer Indian activewear market
items.summary: Hrithik Roshan's HRX grew from a fitness-inspired clothing label into a brand spanning apparel, footwear and more. Its partnership with Myntra, mass-market pricing and focus on product quality helped it scale, with reported revenue exceeding ₹1,500 crore.

items.title: Tata Motors’ €3.43 bn Iveco bid sees 87.8% acceptance, paves way for biggest buyout since JLR: What exchange filing says
items.summary: Tata Motors’ bid for Italian truckmaker Iveco cleared the 80% acceptance threshold, with 87.81% of common shares tendered by the October 26 deadline. The deal, valued at about EUR 3.8 billion, would expand Tata’s global commercial vehicle business.

items.title: Boeing cuts delivery target, shares hit 18-month low as recovery takes longer
items.summary: Boeing has announced a cut in its 737 Max delivery target for this year, which raises concerns. The company now aims to increase 737 production to 52 jets per month in the second half of next year. Boeing reported a wider than expected loss in its commercial airplane division but posted positive free cash flow results. Despite delays, the company plans to begin deliveries of its 777-9 jets next year.

items.title: Infosys draws four downgrades in a day on weaker annual sales outlook
items.summary: Brokerages turn cautious as Infosys' reduced FY27 sales guidance raises concerns over demand recovery and AI-led disruption

items.title: Who are Roman Saini and Gaurav Munjal: From founding online coaching to becoming venture capitalists with ₹700 cr fund
items.summary: The fund has reportedly secured ₹250-300 crore in commitments and plans to back 25-28 early-stage startups, with its first close targeted for January 2027

items.title: GST registration gets easier as CBIC drops Udyam proof, sets seven-day limit for approvals
items.summary: The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs has issued clarifications regarding GST registration requirements for businesses. Companies will no longer need to provide Udyam certificates or face rejections due to unpaid bills. Registration applications must be processed within seven working days with Aadhaar authentication. Tax demands must include clear justifications and cannot be arbitrary. These changes aim…

items.title: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra flags need for 'prudent borrowing' as states face fiscal management challenges
items.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra urged states to improve spending quality, adopt prudent borrowing and strengthen cash management to ensure fiscal sustainability. He also called for wider use of digital platforms for lending and direct benefit transfers.

items.title: Centre eases GST rules for post-sales discounts, no prior agreement needed from November 1
items.summary: The Centre eases GST rules on post-sales discounts from November 1, no longer requiring a prior agreement, which is expected to help FMCG and pharma companies and retailers.

items.title: India to emerge as major exporter to China, ASEAN, get edge in US trade pact, says Piyush Goyal
items.summary: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal highlighted India's potential to expand exports to China and ASEAN. Negotiations are underway for a trade pact with the United States that could provide India a comparative advantage. The country is also working towards an Investment Protection Agreement with the European Union. Goyal indicated that discussions for preferential trade agreements are progressing with…

items.title: Prediction market Kalshi expands safeguards for young traders
items.summary: Kalshi is tightening safeguards for traders aged 18 to 20, introducing a $2,500 monthly deposit limit and alerts for users who put a large share of their funds into one trade. The prediction market also announced partnerships with youth safety groups as scrutiny over gambling risks grows

items.title: GM to transfer stock listing to Nasdaq
items.summary: General Motors made an announcement on Tuesday that they’re moving their common stock listing from the New York Stock Exchange over to Nasdaq. This change is part of their strategy to better position themselves in the market. Investors and analysts are keeping a close eye on how this move will affect GM's stock performance and reputation.
